review_output: {"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR issues in the supplied source. The exhausted-budget fix works: a `budget_exhausted` receipt with `hasMore=false` is now rejected as `invalid_receipt` before its cursor is accepted. The new test confirms the cursor stays at `a`, and a valid exhausted-budget page still continues the pass. Auth comes before body parsing, input is bounded, error messages are sanitized, coverage stays `unknown`, and nothing in this code claims a complete pass means complete collection. Integration limits: the HTTP sendPage adapter isn't included, so I can't verify how it adds `JOB_SECRET`, handles non-200 status codes, limits response size, passes the abort signal through, or which host it targets. Also not provided: the `materializeMetricRegistration` code, whether it is idempotent when two calls run at once, whether `submissionId` is unique within the vendor/live/version scope, and tests for the reconcile module. No scheduler is deployed yet, so overlapping runs and the cross-pass reset to `null` are untested in practice. The findings below are hardening or test gaps.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-pass.ts","area":"timeout/concurrency","issue":"The pass has a 60s total deadline, but a single page can take about 35–45s on the server (up to 10s candidate query, a 20s budget, then one more projection of up to 15s). With maxPages=5, most slow passes will end as `deadline`. Aborting on the client does not stop the server, so its work keeps running without the cursor being accepted. A retry can then process the same rows at the same time as the old request.","evidence":"The 60000ms setTimeout covers the whole loop. The route has maxDuration=60. The server checks its 20s budget once per candidate, and there is no per-scope lease or lock.","impact":"Rows get reprocessed and may be written twice at once. This is safe only if materialize is idempotent under concurrency, which isn't shown here.","recommended_fix":"Make the pass deadline larger than one page's worst case, or add a per-page timeout. Add a per-scope advisory lock or lease, or document and prove that materialize is idempotent under concurrent calls.","required_test":"Use fake timers so a slow second page passes the deadline. Check that the cursor stays at the last accepted page. Add an integration test that runs two overlapping reconciles on one scope and checks that a single consistent record results.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-pass.ts","area":"receipt validation","issue":"Some receipts that contradict the server's rules are still accepted. A `budget_exhausted` receipt must have processed < take, and a `batch_complete` receipt with hasMore must have processed === take. Recorded outcomes are also not checked against processed − retryable − terminalGaps.","evidence":"The validation only rejects `budget_exhausted && !hasMore`, processed > take, and mismatched sums. Outcome keys can be any strings.","impact":"A buggy or stale server can send counters that misreport gaps without being detected. The cursor-safety checks still limit the damage.","recommended_fix":"Reject `budget_exhausted` when processed >= take. Reject `batch_complete && hasMore` when processed !== take. Require (outcomes.recorded ?? 0) === processed − retryable − terminalGaps, and consider limiting outcome keys to the known statuses.","required_test":"Check that each of these contradictory receipts returns `invalid_receipt` and leaves the cursor unchanged.","confidence":0.7},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-reconcile.ts","area":"test coverage","issue":"No tests are provided for how the server decides status, hasMore, and cursor. The pass relies on these rules: budget break, skipping past failures, the take+1 lookahead, and catch mapping to persistence_unavailable.","evidence":"Only live-metric-registration-pass.test.ts is included.","impact":"Changes on the server side could break the client's consistency checks without any test failing.","recommended_fix":"Add unit tests using a fake db and a mocked materialize.","required_test":"Cover these cases: take+1 rows give hasMore=true and batch_complete. Passing 20s on the mocked clock gives budget_exhausted with the cursor at the last processed row. A materialize throw counts as retryable and the cursor still advances. An empty page keeps afterSubmissionId with hasMore=false. A failed candidate query gives PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE, and the route returns 503 with no details.","confidence":0.75},{"severity":"NIT","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-pass.ts","area":"cursor monotonicity","issue":"Progress is checked only against cursors already seen. A server that jumps backward to a cursor not seen before would be accepted.","evidence":"The check is seen.has(page.nextSubmissionId). It does not confirm the new cursor is greater than the current one.","impact":"Some rows would be reworked, but maxPages and the deadline still limit it.","recommended_fix":"Have the server return a monotonic page sequence, or document that collation-dependent ordering can't be compared on the client.","required_test":"A backward cursor not seen before returns `no_progress`, or the test documents that this is accepted.","confidence":0.4},{"severity":"NIT","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-pass.ts","area":"observability","issue":"The pass result does not combine the per-status outcomes from each page, so the scheduler only sees the totals.","evidence":"result() reports processed, retryable, and terminalGaps, but not outcomes.","impact":"The scheduler's reports can't break gaps down by status, such as pending versus terminal.","recommended_fix":"Merge the validated outcome counts into the pass result.","required_test":"The pass result's outcomes equal the sum of the outcomes from each page.","confidence":0.5}]}
